name: James A. Haley Veterans' Hospital
metaTitle: James A. Haley VA: Hospital in Tampa
metaDescription: James A. Haley Veterans' Hospital is at 13000 Bruce B. Downs Blvd. The VA page lists the campus as 24/7 and the main phone as 813-972-2000. Clinics vary.

publish.hoursNote: The page says hours may vary by service even though every day is marked 24/7. Mental health phone 813-631-7100 is separate from the main line.

facts: James A. Haley Veterans' Hospital, Tampa. Address 13000 Bruce B. Downs Boulevard, Tampa, FL 33612-4745, matching our listing 13000 Bruce B Downs Blvd. Main phone 813-972-2000, matching our listing (813) 972-2000. Mental health phone 813-631-7100. Website https://www.va.gov/tampa-health-care/locations/james-a-haley-veterans-hospital/.

The page says the main campus provides 24/7 emergency room care, primary care, and specialty health services, including cardiology, foot care, mental health care, spinal cord injuries, and prosthetics. Facility hours are listed Mon through Sun as 24/7, with the note that hours may vary for different services.

The page says wheelchairs are available on arrival. DAV van schedules vary. A weekday shuttle is mentioned. Some clinics say visit with or without an appointment, and some say by appointment only or that a referral is required.
Nearby from our coordinates: Cano Health 0.38 miles at 13510 University Plaza St, slug cano-health. Aldi 0.4 miles at 13514 University Plaza St, slug aldi-2.

faq.q: Is the whole campus open all night?
faq.a: The location page marks every day 24/7 and says the main campus provides 24/7 emergency room care. It also says hours may vary for different services, so check the clinic you need.
813-972-2000. Mental health is listed separately at 813-631-7100.
The page says DAV van schedules vary and that the hospital works with Disabled American Veterans and county Veterans Affairs directors for rides to scheduled appointments.
